integrity: Original analytic argument and reproducible symbolic checks; primary Chen article inspected through full HTML with some displayed equation renderings unavailable; Chen normalization independently fixed by published governing vector field. Novelty is relative to inspected literature, not a guarantee of priority. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The conclusions classify the axial period-two continuum for a>2c>0 at hb=2 and sufficiently small h, including transverse Floquet indices and local attraction to the family. They do not classify off-axis cycles, the nonlinear wall dynamics, or global basins. The resonance need not persist away from hb=2.
title: Two transverse Floquet walls and an open attracting tube at the Euler–Chen axis flip
